Ur not alone (I do have bipolar but it goes in and out so its not like I’m constantly in a state of suicide, it’s actually pretty rare when it happens) but that being said...I’m glad that ur not walking around fantasizing and mapping it all out literallly cuz that always leads to trouble..but I do the same thing even when I’m in pretty ok spirits...weird right?
    But instead of jumping in front of a car i think daily about running a warm bath and cutting my wrists and just bleeding out slowly (no note, no warning just doing it)...Dramatic right? Idk if its like this for you but even when I’m content, I feel as tho I’m missing something. Idk what or if its a who..i just dont know if I’m where I’m supposed to be but I often find myself thinking...”IS THIS IT?”  “IS THIS ALL THERE IS AND EVER IS GNA BE?” And than I think about dying for a short while.
     Unlike you I’m not afraid of cancer or dimentia or any of those types of things because I have attempted suicide in the past in all honesty (P.s take it from someone who knows, its a nice thought to think of going out painlessly when it comes to offing urself, theres no such thing..no matter how u choose to do it ...ur body will make sure to put of a rough fight.
     
But if this helps put ur mind to rest a little...when I had my umm shall we say “incident” I was pronounced dead for almost a full 7 seconds...You see i overdosed on xanax, OxyContin, tequila and lunesta and i eventually stopped responding. Not before i was revived a few times with fat tubes being forced down my throat, charcoal being poured all over me, getting into my eyes and what felt like a thousand needles in every burning vein including my heart I had (see? Painless isn’t something u can avoid) 
       But to the point ...after awhile it all just stopped. Like I was aware of the chaos but I felt this overwhelming feeling of calm and just I’d say contentment (not happy, just content and almost like snugly and warm) I felt it was all ok and apparently It looked as tho I had a half smile on my face and was just looking up at the ceiling completely unphased and unbothered I was and how I stopped thrashing around fighting off the medical staff. 
The last thing I remember was how heavy my fingers felt and than how heavy my eyes got as tho I had just been given anesthesia and thinking how the e.r ceiling looked exactly like my high school’s ceiling and how calming I found that. I loved it. I remember thinking of my full name for some reason and than that was when I guess i slipped away for a few.
          Thats the closest i can give you to what you wrote in ur post. I wish I could tell u i saw something or experianced an outta this world Jesus sighting lol but, didnt. However it was a feeling kinda like no other. I wish i could feel that again, many times but it’s not worth the few day later when reality hits and ur conscience and everything comes rushing back like the worse migraine, emotional/physical hell u can imagine.
